reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: The alarm reports 'pid_output' as a dead store (line ~11-13) when MARLIN_H=false, PIDTEMP=false, PID_DEBUG=false. When PIDTEMP=false, pid_output is initialized to 1 (line 11) and then set to 0 in the #else block (line 19), but never subsequently read. In the real Marlin manage_heater() code, pid_output is the computed PID output value that drives heating elements — it is used throughout the function. The simplified file stripped all subsequent uses of pid_output. This is a simplification artifact. The known vbdb bug for 8c4377dd635.c is WrongFunArgNum: SERIAL_ECHO_START is called with argument ' PIDDEBUG ' but the macro expands to serialprint(echomagic) taking no additional arguments — that bug requires PIDTEMP=true and PID_DEBUG=true, the opposite configuration.
